notes.title: Golf Gambit 1.0.3-EA Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Golf Gambit 1.0.3-EA Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the out-of-bounds countdown not to start.
[*]Fixed a crash where the host would sometimes crash when starting a match.
[*]Fixed a crash with the out-of-bounds system trying to count the player out when spectating.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the Victory Lap achievement to trigger even if you didn’t win.
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused a benchmark to run in the background during loading screens, causing stutter.
[*]Fixed a bug causing the Discord button on the main menu to scale up when hovered over.
[/list]

[h2]⚙️ Gameplay & System Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made changes to make the physics feel more accurate.
[*]The scoreboard and trap picking menu now hide all other UI elements behind them (e.g. the timer).
[*]Optimized trap video clips, saving almost 200MB of storage!
[/list]

[h2]🎮 New Features & Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added an option to disable tinnitus effects in the settings menu.
[*]Added a warning message if our backend servers are down.
[*]Added a sound when rotating a trap.
[*]Added rarity colors to traps in the trap menu! We now have [b]Common[/b], [b]Rare[/b], and [b]Legendary[/b] traps!
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v1.0.0
notes.content:
⛳ Major Features
Added multiple new swing methods that can be customized in the settings
Added a visual golf club with customization options
Implemented time of day settings - choose between Morning, Afternoon, Evening, and Night
Updated trap selection - the demo now includes all traps from the full game

🔧 UI & Visual Improvements
Showcase of all maps from the main game now featured in the main menu background
Added a new update message highlighting the full game's availability on Steam
Added new settings including local look rotation and more customization options

⭐ Quality of Life
Implemented numerous bug fixes and quality improvements from the full game
Enhanced overall gameplay experience with optimizations and refinements

notes.title: Golf Gambit Update V1.0.2-EA Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]🏌️ Gameplay Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to place traps on certain holes.
[*] Added a wind particle effect to the fan, making it clearer where it will push your ball.
[*] Fixed an issue where the portal would spawn you under the map. This should occur far less frequently now.
[/list]

[h1]🛠️ UI & Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a message to the server browser indicating when there are no active sessions and suggesting you host your own.
[*] Fixed the scoreboard not showing par when playing the last 9 holes.
[/list]

[h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential issue when setting the trap preview material.
[*] Fixed an issue with the half ball that spawns with the laser sometimes not setting the correct material.
[*] Fixed an issue that would spawn you on the wrong hole when playing the last 9 holes.
[/list]

notes.title: Golf Gambit Demo V0.0.4.4.8.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]🏌 Gameplay Adjustments[/h2]
Lower Speed Traps: Adjusted speed traps to account for lower friction, preventing them from being more powerful than intended.
Swing Power Fix: Fixed a bug causing swing power to feel inconsistent—it should now feel more consistent.

[h2]🕹️ Performance & Graphics[/h2]
NVIDIA DLSS Support: Added support for NVIDIA DLSS to improve performance and image quality.
Texture Streaming Optimizations: Made changes to texture streaming, improving overall performance.

[h2]🛠️ UI & Bug Fixes[/h2]
New Connection Feedback: Added text to indicate when you are logging in or connecting, replacing the blank screen.

notes.title: Golf Gambit Demo V0.0.4.4.7.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]🏌️ Gameplay Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]Hole Physics[/h3]

Reduced hole bounciness by 30% to make putts more predictable.

[h3]Ball Behaviour[/h3]

Lowered ball friction by 30% for smoother movement.
Decreased angular dampening by 50%, making spins last longer.
Reduced the speed threshold to stop rolling by 50%, preventing the ball from stopping too soon.

[h2]Course Adjustments[/h2]

Lowered golf grass friction by 25% for a faster playing surface.
Hole 9 Fix: Adjusted the rotation of a moving wooden block that was passing over the hole.

[h2]Power Adjustments[/h2]

Max power reduced by 25% for better shot control.
Minimum power reduced by 50%, allowing for softer putts.
Power application now follows a curve—the first 50% scales slower than the last 50%, providing more precision on short shots and more power on longer swings.

[h2]🎮 UI & Bug Fixes[/h2]

New Input Detection
Added an input screen at the start of the game to detect controller input.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Fixed a bug where your swing could get stuck if you were still swinging when the timer ended.
Updated the Report Bug UI to match the latest design.
Fixed a mislabeled button on the end game screen—it now correctly says “Cancel” instead of “Pause Menu.”

notes.title: Sabotage Your Way to Victory in GolfGambit: Mini-Golf with a Twist!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=EQlimZWTgIk;full][/previewyoutube]

GolfGambit is an electrifying mini-golf experience with a twist! Strategize and set traps before each round to gain the upper hand or throw off your opponents. Get ready to unleash chaos on the green with GolfGambit!


[h2]Traps![/h2]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2761350/extras/Traps-optimize.gif?t=1711558003[/img]
Choose from a vast array of over 40 traps, each offering its own unique twist. Whether you're tipping the scales in your favor or throwing a wrench into your opponent's plans, prepare for chaos on the course!

[h2]Up to 8 players![/h2]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2761350/extras/Multiplayer-optimize.gif?t=1711558003[/img]
Gather up to 7 friends and dive into the madness together, or hone your skills solo. With each player adding their own flavor of chaos, every round promises excitement and laughter!

[h2]Tradiational Mini-Golf![/h2]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2761350/extras/Mini-Golf-optimize.gif?t=1711558003[/img]
For purists who prefer a more traditional approach, simply toggle off the traps and enjoy a classic game of mini-golf with your friends. It's the perfect way to showcase your skills and relive the timeless joy of sinking that perfect putt!

[h2]Multiple Maps & Courses![/h2]
Explore a variety of meticulously crafted maps, each offering multiple courses to conquer. Whether you prefer a quick 9-hole jaunt or a full 18-hole marathon, there's a challenge awaiting every golfer!

[h2]Options Galore![/h2]
Customize your experience to perfection with a plethora of options at your fingertips. Adjust the time limits, set maximum stroke limits, or even disable traps entirely. Whatever your preference, GolfGambit ensures your game is tailor-made to your liking!
